# Community Code of Conduct

We are committed to a respectful, harassment-free community for everyone. Be considerate, use welcoming language, respect differing viewpoints, and focus criticism on ideas and behavior.

Harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, intimidation, and publishing another person's private information are not acceptable.

Maintainers may remove content or restrict participation when needed to keep the community safe. Report conduct concerns privately through the [apimgr organization on GitHub](https://github.com/orgs/apimgr/people).
